title: Nuclear Construction Starts, Concentration, And Capacity Form One Buildout
hook: The nuclear buildout is active, large, and concentrated in one country.
closing: Today's nuclear construction map will shape where future generating capacity comes online.
question: Will nuclear construction keep growing?

segments.say: Ten nuclear reactor projects started construction in 2025. The worldwide buildout is still adding new projects.
China holds 50% of nuclear capacity under construction. Half of the active buildout is concentrated there.
Worldwide nuclear construction totals 78 gigawatts. That concentrated pipeline adds up to substantial generating capacity.
